name: IHUB ANUBHUTI
description: Technology Innovation Hub (TiH) on "Cognitive Computing and Social Sensing" for Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems (ICPS), called iHub Anubhuti IIITD Foundation also referred to here as ‘iHub Anubhuti’, has been established by Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi as a Section 8 Company under the aegis of the National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems (NM-ICPS) of the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. iHub Anubhuti IIITD Foundation (hereby referred to as iHub Anubhuti) is the National Center for Cognitive Computing & Social Sensing. iHub Anubhuti aims at building a collaboration between industries, academia, and government agencies on developing data-driven cognitive computing solutions, mainly in verticals - Health, Law Enforcement & Security, Education, and Environmental Sustainability. It will also encourage and promote the entrepreneurial activities and start-ups emanating from the projects in the areas of “Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Cognitive Computing & Social Sensing”.

name: Gujarat Foundation for Entrepreneurial Excellence
description: iCreate (International Centre for Entrepreneurship and Technology) is an autonomous centre of excellence of the Government of Gujarat and is India’s leading institution for transforming startups based on tech innovation into successful businesses. Located in a state-of-the-art 40-acre campus at Dev Dholera in Ahmedabad. To date,it has supported 389 innovations and 30 patents with a ‘high-touch,entrepreneur first model,connecting them with mentors,markets and money. Embedded systems and IoT are a focus area for iCreate,in domains like Electric Vehicles,Renewable Energy,Agritech,Healthtech,Fintech,Watertech,among others. In addition,it is home to Cisco's largest Innovation Lab in India and has partnerships with leading institutions in the US,Israel,and other countries.

name: ABLEST
description: Association for Bio-inspired Leaders & Entrepreneurs at SASTRA TBI (ABLEST) is a part of SASTRA’s incubation ecosystem supported by Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) and SASTRA Deemed-to-be University with a goal to develop and support startups in niche technological areas including therapeutics, diagnostics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, MedTech devices and other biotechnology domains. ABLEST is a section 8 non-profit organization and a BioNEST that is focused on developing startups from ideation to product launch by bridging the gaps between the conceptualization and commercialization through access to world-class infrastructure facilities, one-on-one mentoring, scalable & sustainable business plans and industries & investors network. We, at ABLEST, are promoting startups based on therapeutics, diagnostics, MedTech devices and smart healthcare solutions by providing the required space for R&D of innovations that are commercial in the front and societal at its core.

name: ACIC GIET UNIVERSITY FOUNDATION
description: To promote entrepreneurship and the startup ecosystem in the tribal region of Odisha, ACIC GIET UNIVERSITY FOUNDATION was established in 2020, with the support from AIM, Niti Aayog GoI operating under the auspices of GIET University. In order to help all aspiring innovators market their ideas and breakthroughs, ACIC GIETU FOUNDATION offers a comprehensive range of incubation facilities, including mentors for technological and business growth, CoEs, and support services. Across the board, the center supports entrepreneurs and inventors in the fields of ICT, Digital Technologies, Engineering, Cleantech, Fintech, Healthcare, Agriculture, Bio Sciences, and Food Tech. Our main areas of focus are developing innovators, enhancing their entrepreneurship abilities, and helping them launch a business to meet the Sustainable Development Goals.

name: AIC-JKLU
description: AIC-JKLU is established with the support of AIM,NITI Aayog,and JK Lakshmipat University in 2019. In the last 3 years,AIC-JKLU has supported 50 startups in various sectors including Fintech,Ed-tech,EVs,Agritech,and more. The AIC,due to its association with JKLU,is uniquely able to provide start-ups access to interdisciplinary resources such as high-end computing facilities,design facilities,and engineering labs(33+ labs) coupled with expert resources in the areas of business,technology,and design(43+ mentors & 33+ partners). In the coming years,AIC-JKLU aims to build an eco-system to focus specifically on Longevity Economy & Energy.

name: AIC IIITKOTTAYAM FOUNDATION
description: The incubation centre,AIC IIITKottayam Foundation,is a non-profit Sec.8 company. It is hosted by the Indian Institute of Information Technology Kottayam,an institute of national importance,under Atal Innovation Mission scheme of NITI Aayog,Govt. of India. The centre addresses the existing problems of entrepreneurs by providing them sufficient input in terms of knowledge,guidance,mentoring,training,and so forth. In fact,the centre has established sufficient international tie-ups in leading Universities/centres to nourish startups. The centre focuses on leading technologies such as IoT,Cloud,and blockchain solutions for societal benefits.

name: Indigram Labs Foundation
description: Founded in 2015 as a Technology Business Incubator under Section 8 of the Companies Act 2013,the Indigram Labs Foundation (ILF) is a subsidiary non-profit company of the ISAP India Foundation and supported by the National Science and Technology Entrepreneurship Development Board. ILF has supported over 150 startups in India,leveraging cutting-edge technologies like IoT,AI,and machine learning to provide agri-food supply chain players with the latest information,technology,capital,and networks. ILF is recognized for its technology business incubation services and strong connections with institutions,mentors,and investors. It offers a strong network of angel investors,go-to-market expertise,access to high-quality mentors,and market linkages. ILF has achieved notable recognition and success,including prestigious awards and partnerships,generating employment,and benefiting farmers through its startups' innovative solutions.

name: Neuron - Centre of Entrepreneurship
description: STPI Neuron, a Centre of Entrepreneurship (CoE) in AI/Data Analytics, IoT and AVG has been setup in collaboration with Govt. of Punjab, ISB-Mohali, PTU and Meity. This is an initiative, to identify and evaluate promising start-ups in the field of AI/Data Analytics, IoT and AVG which are being hosted in the Startup Punjab Hub-Neuron at STPI Mohali Incubation Facility. Startup Punjab Hub@STPI Mohali has dedicated 500 seats co-working space and dedicated labs for AI/Data Analytics, IoT and AVG. Apart from physical infrastructure, the hub will have the access to Technocrats mentorship, mentorship programs and VC funding agencies.

name: Maker Village
description: Maker Village is India's largest electronic hardware incubator and Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) facility,under the aegis of the Union Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology and the State Government of Kerala. We have a 60,000 sq.ft facility in the largest Integrated Startup Complex in the country,with around several hardware startups engaged in deep tech and advanced areas such as Automation,AI/ ML,Robotics,Drones,IoT,Autonomous Vehicles,AR/ VR,Biomedical Instrumentation,Additive Manufacturing,Energy & Utilities,et al. The facility has co-working spaces,electronics and instrumentation labs,metal machining area,industrial 3D printing and plastics facility and industrial SMT lines. We also enable a platform for the industry,academia and the startups to collaborate and create products and IP. We are building the most thriving and equipped hardware ecosystem in the country and aim to become an entrepreneurial hotspot of all makers from anywhere in the world and attract the best startups and entrepreneurs to the facility. Maker Village intends to promote hardware-focused innovation and set up labs and centres that emphasize on the current trend and emerging technologies of disruptive nature to bring India to the forefront of innovation in these areas.

name: KLE CTIE Centre for Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship
firm: KLE CTIE Centre for Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship
description: KLE CTIE - Centre for Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship has been founded as a society by KLE Technological University in the year 2012. Vision to be a pioneer-to foster , enable and grow the innovation and entrepreneurial ecosystem in Tier-II Cities in India . We are recognized by Department of Science and Technology ,Government of India as Technology Business Incubator . Recognized as Tide 2.0 G2 centre by Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology , Government of India . Recognized as Nidhi Seed Support Scheme Centre by NSTEDB. Supported by Startup India Seed Fund, the startup India initiative of the GoI. In the last 10 years the KLE-CTIE has incubated 145+ startups , 20cr investment raised by startups, 2cr fund disbursed to startups,2500+ employment created in Hubli-Dharwad region . Focused Domains are ESDM/VLSI, Embedded , IoT, AI, ML,ITES , FoodTech, MedTech,AgriTech ,EduTech, Biotech, Automotive & Robotics etc

name: VEL TECH - TECHNOLOGY INCUBATOR
description: Vel Tech Technology Incubator enables technology-embedded and innovation-powered start-ups to survive and scale across a wide spectrum of thrust areas with funding,infrastructure,mentorship,industry networking,resources,and training. Vel Tech TBI was received national recognition as NIDHI - Centre of Excellence catalyzed and Supported by NSTEDB Division,Department of Science and Technology (DST). NIDHI CoE @ Vel Tech TBI has created facility such as Manufacturing CoE,IT/ITES (Al/ML/DL - DGX - I Platform),E-Waste recycling,3D Printing,and PCB Line of Equipment to support startups,industry units and academic research.OUR JOURNEY - 2010 established TBI to promote startups in e-waste management,Bio-waste,and Additive manufacturing facility. 2015 DST - Seed Support System (SSS) to provide financial support to Incubatees. 2017 NIDHI CoE recognition to Establish Manufacturing CoE,PCB facility,3D Printing,and AI Super Computer Centre of Excellence,2018 NIDHI PRAYAS funding (idea to Prototype grant),2020 MeitY TIDE 2.0 funding (EiR and idea to Prototype grant to support ICT Innovations).OUR VISION: To be a World Class Incubator and Accelerator with a successful track record of incubating leading products,solutions,and services.Vel Tech TBI Ecosystem is rich in diversity with startups in terms of quality and quantity. Vel Tech TBI gives life to your ideas.

name: Ahmedabad University Support Foundation (VentureStudio)
description: VentureStudio is a startup incubation centre at Ahmedabad University. It was established in 2011,in collaboration with Stanford University Design School. Since inception,the centre has supported more than 120 startups in diverse technological domains such as Healthcare,BioTechnology,Life Sciences,Medical Devices,Diagnostics,Engineering,Industry 4.0 and Deep Tech Software Technologies. In 2017,the centre was chosen to support BioIncubation activities in Gujarat by the Department of BioTechnology. VentureStudio also hosts Prayas Shala Fab Shop as well as BioNest Biotechnology lab to provide solid infrastructure support to upcoming startups.

name: Science & Technology Entrepreneurship Park
description: Science & Technology Entrepreneurship Park is on a mission to contribute toward making India into a technologically and economically advanced entrepreneurship ecosystem through various programs and supporting early-stage companies building disruptive businesses for India in emerging sectors such as Healthcare,Education,Agriculture,Financial & deep tech through leading technologies like IoT,AI,Blockchain,and Robotics,etc. We partner with promising teams at a very early stage to support Strategy,Business Development growth,and Investment access through customized and focused incubation support and mentoring We focus on specific aspects across each of these support areas:Strategy: Examine fundamental business activities such as revenue model,target audience,go-to-market strategy,customer acquisition channels,and product-to-market fit.Business Development: Assisting businesses with new clients,placing a foot in new distribution access,and creating negotiating techniques via our industry-focused coaches. Investment Access: Building financial plans and projections,putting KPIs in place,structuring investment needs,and broadening access to the right investor group.It takes strength,confidence,trust,and determination to endure the entrepreneurial path. The delivery of new structures,business models,processes,products and services,and experiences poses founders with challenges. You need a companion when you go out on your path who can assist you in positioning yourself for success.

name: Atal Incubation Centre, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Marathwada University Aurangabad
firm: Atal Incubation Centre, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Marathwada University Aurangabad
description: Atal Incubation Center- AIC-BAMU Foundation promoted by D Babasaheb Ambedkar Marathwada University and supported by Maharashtra State Innovation Society,Department of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship,Govt of Maharashtra & Atal Innovation Mission,NITI Aayog,Govt. of India aims to foster the culture of Innovation and entrepreneurship by supporting technology-based start-ups & developing an ecosystem which is conducive for innovation,where start-ups and new ventures thrive. It also has been providing the essential Highly equipped DGX,AL-ML laboratory,Innovation and invention Centre (IPR Centre),Co working spaces,specialized facilities-IOT Fab lab,sophisticated AR-VR laboratory,Central Digital Library Facility AIC-BAMU Foundation invites innovative ideas in the field of IOT,AR,VR,ML in the areas of Healthcare,Auto Industrial applications and allied areas The Incubation Centre is to nurture the student's idea to promote and encourage them to pursue a career in entrepreneurship. The Incubation Centre is committed to mentor,guide,and support and facilitates the budding entrepreneurs in successfully launching their ventures. The Incubators' services include expert connect,association with mentors,help in fundraising,access to physical infrastructure including workstations,conference hall,meeting rooms,shared office resources,technical and management assistance and networking with the stakeholders.

name: Biotechnology Incubation Centre (BIC-HPU)
description: Biotechnology Incubation Centre (BIC-HPU) an entrepreneurship development centre funded by Dept. of Industries,Govt. of Himachal Pradesh,under the Chief Minister Startup Scheme with the bigger mission of Make in India,was established on 22nd June 2017 in the Department of Biotechnology,HP University,Shimla. It aims to strengthen the entrepreneurial skills and provide students with knowledge,mentorship & facilities to emerge as successful entrepreneur’s/ job generators for future. Any novel and innovative idea from Science,Humanities,Management,Tourism or any other field that can be converted into a profitable venture is welcomed at this centre from any citizen,farmer,skilled/unskilled worker and others. BIC-HPU has created an enabling ecosystem to nurture entrepreneurs. BIC-HPU’s understanding is that the building blocks for such an enabling ecosystem are finding and mentoring entrepreneurs,a pool of innovative and replicable ideas,funding for seed and growth stage of enterprises,partnerships with peer organizations and a physical environment that facilitates a virtuous cross-fertilization of processes,techniques and network advantage with accountability. Our vision is to create an incubation ecosystem in Himachal Pradesh that supports successful transformation of ideas into vibrant and thriving Startups as well as uplift the economy of the State.

name: i-RISE (IISER-Raising Innovative and Sustainable Enterprises) TBI-IISER Mohali
firm: i-RISE (IISER-Raising Innovative and Sustainable Enterprises) TBI-IISER Mohali
description: With the purpose of encouraging innovation and entrepreneurship in the field of science and technology, i-RISE TBI IISER Mohali is a unique initiative by the Department of Science and Technology and IISER Mohali. TBI has exclusively supported 33 startups so far. These startups are working in different domains including Healthcare, Biotech, Rural waste management, Environmental sustainability, Animal Husbandry and Farming, IoT, AI-ML, Agriculture and allied sectors. TBI IISER Mohali works closely with these Startups towards capacity building, venture development, project pilots, industry partnerships, and business expansion, and supporting them with the help of different interventions.

name: IIT Guwahati Technology Incubation Centre Guwahati (IITG-TIC)
firm: IIT Guwahati Technology Incubation Centre Guwahati (IITG-TIC)
description: IITG Technology Incubation Centre (IITG-TIC) is registered as a Society under the Registration of Societies Act XXI of 1860. Its goal is to encourage entrepreneurial initiatives amongst the faculty and alumni of the IITG community in particular and other State or Central Government Technical Institutions of the North East. It is an opportunity to explore and implement the innovative ideas into a commercially viable product through technology startup companies. This centre facilitates interdisciplinary research with special emphasis on development and innovation of high-growth- knowledge-based-business and nurtures the indigenous products with innovative hardware/embedded designs. Technical support,business mentoring and soft loan facility subject to availability are the key services of this centre. Spreading across an area of approximately 4000 square meters within the Technology Complex of IIT Guwahati,IITG TIC has the adequate infrastructure for this endeavour. Currently,funds for developing basic infrastructure and soft loan facility is given by the Department of Information Technology,Govt. of India. IITG TIC is also one of the Business Incubators approved and recognized by the Ministry of Micro,Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME),Govt. of India. The Technology Development Board,under the Ministry of Science & Technology,Govt. of India,has also approved grant assistance to IITG TIC to support Start-ups units. IITG TIC has an Eight-member Governing Body under the Chairmanship of the Director of IIT Guwahati. A Management Council directs and administers the smooth functioning of the IITG TIC. Currently,the Management Team of the IITG TIC is led by a Chairperson.

name: MOTION Centre of Entrepreneurship (CoE)
description: "MOTION", is a Centre of Entrepreneurship (CoE) in Autonomous/ Connected/ Electric / Shared (ACES) Mobility, an initiative of Software Technology Parks of India (STPI), Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology at Pune, with specialized state-of-the-art incubation facility and domain specific physical laboratories for start-ups working in the area of Autonomous Connected Electric Shared Mobility where the highest-standards and best-practices in terms of infrastructure, technology, leadership, mentoring, training, research & development, funding, networking for the given focus area is made available.

name: AIC - Pondicherry Engineering College Foundation
description: Atal Incubation Centre - Pondicherry Engineering College Foundation (AIC-PECF) is fully supported and funded by Atal Innovation Mission (AIM),Niti Aayog,Government of India. AIC-PECF was initiated to provide a platform to assist and enable young entrepreneurs to initiate startups and commercialize the technological solutions developed by them. Entrepreneurship and innovation are critical for the growth of any economy,in an increasingly competitive world. They become even more critical for India as its demographic dividend can only be realized with rapid creation of employment and income generation opportunities. Global experience shows that,apart from creating wealth and boosting the economy,new businesses also create disproportionately more jobs than established ones. AIC-PECF actively creates an environment for the young innovators to test their business ideas with minimal risks. AIC-PECF also enables the budding 1st Gen entrepreneurs to showcase and test their abilities to run a start up business in the areas of Electronics design and Manufacturing (EDM),Internet of Things(IoT) and Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV).

name: Atal Incubation Centre - Centre for Cellular & Molecular Biology (AIC-CCMB)
firm: Atal Incubation Centre - Centre for Cellular & Molecular Biology (AIC-CCMB)
description: Atal Incubation Centre at the Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (AIC-CCMB) is a premier incubator focused on promoting entrepreneurship in life sciences,supporting start-ups in Health,Pharmaceuticals and Biotechnology. CSIR — CCMB is one of the first 10 institutes to establish the Atal Incubation Centre under the Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) of National Institution for Transforming India (NITI Aayog). Innovations in life sciences are critical to improve the quality of life of the general population. As Indian researchers and innovators begin to expand the boundaries of science,pursuing novel therapies,diagnostics,medical devices and industrial solutions,we ensure that their technologies are translated into sustainable business solutions that reach the citizens.

name: PDEU Innovation and Incubation Centre
description: PDEU Innovation and Incubation Centre (PDEU IIC),(Formerly PDPU Innovation and Incubation Centre),is an incubator established by Pandit Deendayal Energy,with a vision to provide state of the art support and service to innovators,technocrats and entrepreneurs who aim to create a social and economic impact in the society through innovative solutions to existing problems. The centre acts complementary to the academic and research activities of the University. PDEU IIC is recognised as NIDHI-TBI by DST,GoI; Nodal Institute by Industries Commissionerate (IC),GoG; Electronics & IT/ITeS Start-up Incubator by DST,GoG.

name: Foundation for Innovation & Research at SASTRA TBI - FIRST
firm: Foundation for Innovation & Research at SASTRA TBI - FIRST
description: SASTRA has obtained grant to establish its Technology Business Incubator (TBI) in FY2017-18 and the TBI has been setup at SASTRA’s Thanjavur Campus called Foundation for Innovation & Research at SASTRA Technology Business Incubator (FIRST). Supported by the Department of Science & Technology,Government of India,the objective of the FIRST TBI is to nurture entrepreneurs in the twin areas of Additive Manufacturing and internet of things. FIRST TBI provides various facilities to the incubates & the Innovators which includes Rapid Prototyping labs in the areas of 3D Printing,IOT,Virtual Reality & Drones,supported by fully loaded Wi-Fi enabled cubicles,conference rooms,library and other facilities. We also have a Biotechnology TBI called Association for Bio-inspired Leaders & Entrepreneurs at SASTRA – TBI (ABLEST) is supported by the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC),Department of Biotechnology,Government of India. ABLEST focuses on supporting start-ups in the areas of therapeutics,diagnostics,pre–clinical evaluation and smart health care solution

name: Karnavati Innovation Incubation Foundation (KIIF)
description: Karnavati Innovation and Incubation Foundation (KIIF) is a design business incubator that works on an amalgamation of design,technology and business principles located within the campus of Karnavati University. The incubation centre has been established with the vision to nurture innovations by creating an ecosystem that would foster the entrepreneurial spirit among youth and contribute towards making India an innovative and creative nation. It has been formed to help startups and entrepreneurs in their journey towards becoming successful businesses. Through its hallmark business assistance services,it would render much needed support to companies sprouting their way into the business world. The incubated companies will have access to corporate like work-spaces,domain expert mentors and cutting-edge labs to take their idea to emerge out into a successful and profitable business venture. KIIF is recognised as Nodal Institute by Industries Commissionerate (IC),GoG; Electronics & IT/ITeS Start-up Incubator by DST,GoG.

name: MedTech- A CoE in MediElectronics and Health Informatics
firm: MedTech- A CoE in MediElectronics and Health Informatics
description: MedTech: A Center of Entrepreneur in field of Medical equipment/electronics and Health Informatics. This novel initiative has been set up by a consortia comprising of Software Technology Parks of India (STPI), SGPGI Lucknow, Department of IT and Electronics, Government Of UP, Association Of Medical Device Industry (AIMED), Andhra Pradesh MedTech Zone (AMTZ) along with Kalam Institute of Health Technology (KIHT). The objectives of opening the same is to boost start-ups in the field of medical equipment/electronics & health informatics, and, to contribute to "Make-in-India" & "Digital India" programs of Govt. of India by reducing Health Care Equipment imports and recognize value of Health Care Equipment & Technology locally.

name: Golden Jubilee Biotech Park for Women Society
firm: Golden Jubilee Biotech Park for Women Society
description: Golden Jubilee Biotech Park for Women was established with a vision of encouraging and empowering \\Women Entrepreneurs\ 2 decades ago. This organization is supported by Department of Biotechnology,Govt. of India,Govt. of Tamil Nadu and technical support from MSSRF. We have established companies which have their R&D and manufacturing units within our campus. Bio-Incubation Centre (Supported by BIRAC) is a co-working space for women from life-science sector. Since the inception Park is committed to encourage and empower Women Entrepreneurs who are in the field of Biotech,Life Science stream from across country and especially from Tamil Nadu. Park has eminent expertise from the various walk of academia and industry. Mentorship is provided to incubatees for statutory compliances,taxations,fund raising and other B2B,B2C ventures.

name: Crescent Innovation & Incubation Council(CIIC)
description: Crescent Innovation & Incubation Council(CIIC),established as a Section-8 not for profit company is the innovation arm of B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology(BSACIST),Chennai funded by BioNEST BIRAC,Department of Biotechnology,Govt. of India and positioned as the 3rd Best Bio-Incubator of India 2020 by Biospectrum Magazine. CIIC has been acting as a “One Stop Shop – Technology Business Incubator (TBI)” for startups in the field of Life Sciences,Industry 4.0 and Mobility and Transportation. CIIC aims to support & render start-up into a profitable entity through the mission statement called Triple ‘M’ – Market,Money and Mentor transforming innovation into scalable business models with high productive impact,encouraging interdisciplinary advancement both nationally and internationally. CIIC is recognized by the European Commission for collaborative projects and soft landing of startups. CIIC is administered by 10+ full time team with industry background to support startups. Atal Ranking of Institutions on Innovation Achievements (ARIIA),Ministry of Education,GoI has ranked BSACIST under Band A (6-25) through the support of CIIC. Also BSACIST has received a 5-star rating for Institutional Innovation Council,Ministry of Education,Govt of India within a year of operation.

name: Startup Incubation and Innovation Centre IIT Kanpur
firm: Startup Incubation and Innovation Centre IIT Kanpur
description: Start-up Incubation and Innovation Centre (SIIC),IIT Kanpur aims to create impact at the bottom of the pyramid. Established in the year 2000,SIIC is one of the oldest technology business incubators with many successes under its belt. The multifaceted,vibrant incubation ecosystem nurtured over two decade’s aims to fill all the gaps on the road to convert an idea into a business. SIIC has developed the experience base and ecosystem that become critical ingredients in developing early stage,technology-focused start-ups disrupting paradigms across the domains such as biotech,agritech,healthcare,aerospace,energy,and WASH.

name: Centre for Cellular and Molecular Platforms (C-CAMP)
firm: Centre for Cellular and Molecular Platforms (C-CAMP)
description: C-CAMP,a Department of Biotechnology,Government of India initiative,has established itself as one of the largest and most thriving,deep science innovation hubs for technology-based innovation in India in the field of life sciences. C-CAMP enables cutting-edge bio-science research and entrepreneurship by: i) developing and making available state-of-the-art technologies to academia and industry,and ii) building a thriving ecosystem to stimulate innovation and promote biotech entrepreneurship in India. C-CAMP’s mission is to enable high-end scientific research and foster deep science innovations for societal impact.

name: Technology Incubation and Entrepreneurship Development Society (TIEDS)
firm: Technology Incubation and Entrepreneurship Development Society (TIEDS)
description: Technology Incubation and Entrepreneurship Development Society (TIEDS) has been established to promote innovation and entrepreneurship in the region. We nurture and foster a culture of innovation and technology-led entrepreneurship contributing to national development. We believe in economical harmony and stand to create a conducive environment for entrepreneurship. We also facilitate,improve,promote,train and support creative thinking,idea generation to transform them into business opportunities. TIEDS has built a strong ecosystem and experience base that is crucial for developing technology-focused start-ups. These start-ups are disrupting industries such as biotech,agritech,healthcare,and energy.

name: AIC-Nitte Incubation Centre
description: The AIC NITTE Incubation Centre is situated amidst the luscious green fields of Nitte,Karlala,India. The Centre has started its operation on June 01,2020,and was officially launched by Shri N.Vinaya Hegde,Chancellor Nitte Deemed to be University,and Shri Ramanan,Mission Director Atal Innovation Mission,NITI Aayog on August 07,2020. Within a short period,the Centre has onboarded 32 startups (19 Residents + 13 Virtual). The Centre aims to accelerate the entrepreneurial vision of the country by encouraging and providing assistance to budding entrepreneurs who want to create startups in the areas of Agriculture,Biotechnology and ITCs to nurture their Novel innovative ideas. The main objective of AIC Nitte is to foster innovation and entrepreneurship among young men and women. The Centre offers start-ups valuable guidance,technological assistance,access to investors,networking,and facilitating a host of other services. Start-ups also receive direction through the robust chain of Mentors who give sector-specific information and real-time practical guidance. Further,the Centre will also support the existing MSMEs in the region through appropriate intervention strategies like training,consultancy/mentoring,business development,diversification,technology transfer & up-gradation. The Centre would network with industry associations and trade bodies to identify research,training,education,consulting and development needs of the MSME sector.

name: SR Innovation Exchange, SRiX
description: SR Innovation Exchange (SRiX) is a center for promoting entrepreneurship by facilitating technology innovators to create products or services and providing the resources required to go to market with their innovation. We bring start-ups,co-working ventures,industry mentors,eminent academic experts,and researchers together at our state-of-the-art facility to create a unique ecosystem where the continuous interactions between people and ideas lead to new technological innovations and successful commercialization. Ideas are of the mind. We aim to make those ideas real by manifesting them into products - hardware or software. The product must have a positive impact on the users and ecosystem. SRiX aims to help you make your ideas matter by making them real and impactful.

name: AIC-GISC FOUNDATION (Atal Incubation Center - GISC Foundation)
firm: AIC-GISC FOUNDATION (Atal Incubation Center - GISC Foundation)
description: Atal Incubation Center – Gujarat Innovation and Startup Center Foundation (AIC-GISC) promoted by Gujarat Technological University supported by Atal Innovation Mission,NITI Aayog aims to foster the culture of Innovation and entrepreneurship by supporting technology based start-ups & developing an ecosystem which is conducive for innovation,where start-ups and new ventures thrive. Incubation center has been created in a modest infrastructure for providing the essential Dedicated Lab Suites,Shared Lab,Co working spaces,specialized facilities – Fabrication lab,Sophisticated laboratory,Central Instrumentation Facility. AIC at GTU has an advantage of access to resources of GTU in field of Engineering,Architecture,Management,Pharmacy and Computer science with more than 400+ affiliated colleges in its fold operating across the State of Gujarat.

name: Sathyabama - TBI
description: Technology Business Incubator - popularly known as Sathyabama-TBI,was established with the support of NSTEDB-DST,Govt of India and registered under the Societies Registration Act,1975 on 27th December 2012 to promote innovation and entrepreneurship. Since its inception,the incubator has been focusing on Marine Bio Resource Utilization and Engineering and upgraded to Engineering Technology,Sustainable Blue Economy,Social Impact and Manufacturing,making Sathyabama-TBI as one of the unique incubators across the country in the sector of Blue Economy. So far the incubator has supported 57 startups with over 120+ employment opportunities generated with the support of 30+ partners and 30+ technical mentors. The incubation centre has an infrastructure spread over 22,000 sq.ft and is functioning inside the Col. Dr. Jeppiaar Research Park,Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology. Chennai,Tamil Nadu. Sathyabama TBI has framed several initiatives to support startups that includes,Proto Cafe - to support students in their prototype development; Mentor Cafe - to support students and early stage entrepreneurs with right mentorship and market connects; Investor Cafe - to connect startups with their potential investors; Virtual Incubation Program and so on.

name: IIT Ropar - Technology and Innovation Foundation (AWaDH)
firm: IIT Ropar - Technology and Innovation Foundation (AWaDH)
description: IIT Ropar Technology and Innovation Foundation (iHub – AWaDH) for Agriculture and Water Technology Development Hub is established by the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India, at the Indian Institute of Technology Ropar in the framework of National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber Physical Systems (NM – ICPS) with time-bound predefined deliverables. With a funding support of 110 Cr through DST Govt of India, IIT Ropar Technology & Innovation Foundation support deep-tech research ideas. startups, innovators. The hub supports R&D in the domain of Agriculture, Water, IoT, ICPS provides incubation & acceleration resources and support to technology-based start-ups towards sustainable agriculture.

name: CIPET CTEF INNOVEX
description: CTEF: INNOVEX Cell is committed to build and thrive an inclusive ecosystem in which entrepreneurs can work closely with industry experts, investors & stakeholders to achieve goal. The CELL is determined to support in developing the entrepreneurial ideas into viable businesses by providing essential nurturing. It helps start-ups to navigate themselves in their early stages which escalate their chances of success. name: JECRC Incubation Centre

name: Bio Valley Incubation Council
description: Bio Valley Incubation Council (BVIC) is a BIRAC BioNEST incubation arm of AMTZ's unique ecosystem which is recognized as a Scientific and Industrial Research Organization (SIRO) by DSIR.
